create_timestep_embedder: create a TimestepEmbedder instance with a given hidden size and frequency embedding size
call_forward_embed_timesteps: call forward on TimestepEmbedder to embed scalar timesteps into vector representations
generate_sinusoidal_timestep_embedding: generate sinusoidal timestep embeddings from a 1-D tensor of indices using timestep_embedding
freeze_timestep_embedder: freeze the TimestepEmbedder MLP weights by passing freeze=True during initialization
review_timestep_embedder_mlp: review the TimestepEmbedder MLP architecture with SiLU activation and two linear layers
